name: PretendPro Office Suite
description: Wholesome parody office suite: browser-based fake-content demo tools for realistic product screenshots and demos. Documentation surface only — this is a static site with no API, no accounts, and no interactive agent endpoint.

skills.name: Browse the demo tools
skills.description: List and describe the eleven fake-content demo tools: DocuFaker (fake document editor), SheetShenanigans (fake spreadsheet), BrowserBuddy (fake browser), Inbox Mirage (fake email inbox), CodeFaker (fake web code editor), CodeFaker: Game (fake game-dev editor), DeckDreamer (fake slide-deck builder), ReaderRealm (fake PDF reader), PhotoPretender (fake photo editor), ReelPretender (fake video editor), and SoundStage (fake audio editor).

skills.name: Resolve a tool page URL
skills.description: Resolve the canonical URL for any tool inside any pretend OS edition and locale, following the pattern https://pretend.pro/{locale}/{edition}/{tool} — for example https://pretend.pro/us-en/fruit/docufaker. Editions: fruit, apperture, bufferium, android, fos. Locales: us-en, ca-en, uk-en, au-en, at-en, tlh.

skills.name: Describe the pretend OS editions
skills.description: Describe the five pretend operating-system editions: Fruit (Mac OS X style desktop with a dock), Apperture (Windows style desktop with a start bar), BufferiumOS (a shelf desktop that is eternally almost done), Android (Android-style phone home screen), and fOS (fOS-style phone with a dock and home indicator).

skills.name: Locate key site pages
skills.description: Locate the key pages of the site: the onboarding homepage (https://pretend.pro/), locale homepages, open-source licenses (/{locale}/licenses), privacy policy (/{locale}/privacy), terms of service (/{locale}/terms), the XML sitemap (/sitemap.xml), and the llms.txt overview (/llms.txt).
